about: The agent tools the studio publishes (WebMCP and window.dailyStudio) and the inputs each requires. test/e2e-agent.cjs fails if a tool here disappears or its required inputs change: that is a breaking change, which needs AG_API raised in src/parts/72-agent.js (or an alias in AG_ALIAS) and this file updated on purpose. New tools and new optional inputs are fine.
